entities.name: Wizards' School
entities.description: Institute of magical study on Ulgrotha, built by Feroz on the Floating Island.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Planeswalker who created the Wizards' School and later vanished.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Drove the dwarves of New Freedom from their home.

entities.name: Sea Dwarves
entities.description: Dwarves who sailed the seas and found the school built on their island.

entities.name: Floating Island
entities.description: Island where the school was built.

entities.name: Council of Wizards
entities.description: Ruling body led by a Wizard Savant, keeping the seas open and neutral.

events.summary: Feroz builds a great school on the Floating Island, astonishing the returning Sea Dwarves.
events.quote: he built a great school there and created wells of fresh water

events.summary: The First Master vanishes, leaving magical texts; after chaos a Council of Wizards is formed.
events.quote: the First Master vanished, leaving behind a number of his magical texts

relations.quote: the school was led by Reveka
